sobreNosotros.title: We build technology people use.
sobreNosotros.subhead: We're a software studio between Barcelona and Israel. We design and build websites, apps and custom tools for organisations and businesses in any sector.
paragraphs: We began by solving a problem we knew first-hand: organisations running on WhatsApp groups, spreadsheets and hours of manual work. That's where Kehál came from, the app Chabad Barcelona uses today.

Soon businesses with the same need to get organised and grow called us: an online shop in London, a property developer, a coffee brand, an education platform. Each one with a different solution, built for it.
Today we work across three lines (communities, schools and businesses) with the same method: listen first, build to measure and stay alongside you after launch.
sobreNosotros.pullQuote: Custom software, built for people to actually use.

sections.heading: What data do we collect?
paragraphs: Through the Website's contact form and/or meeting-booking feature, we collect the data users voluntarily provide: name, email address, phone (optional) and the content of the message or inquiry. No sensitive data or ID documents are collected through this corporate website.

sections.heading: For what purpose do we process your data?
paragraphs: To respond to inquiries received through the contact form, manage meeting/demo bookings, and, if the user expressly consents, send commercial communications related to Chai Active's services.

sections.heading: What is the legal basis for processing?
paragraphs: The data subject's consent, given when filling out and submitting the relevant form (art. 6.1.a GDPR).

sections.heading: How long will we keep your data?
paragraphs: Data will be kept for as long as a commercial or mutual-interest relationship exists, and in any case for the legally established periods to address potential liabilities. If there is no response or continued contact, data will be kept for a maximum of [e.g. 24 months] before deletion.

sections.heading: Who will your data be shared with?
paragraphs: Data will not be shared with third parties, except where legally required. We may rely on technology providers acting as data processors (for example: a hosting/deployment provider [Vercel], or an email/form management tool [Resend]), who will process data only under THE OWNER's instructions and with the guarantees required by the GDPR (including, where applicable, international transfer clauses if the provider is outside the European Economic Area).

sections.heading: What are your rights?
paragraphs: Anyone has the right to obtain confirmation as to whether Chai Active is processing personal data concerning them, and in particular has the right to access their personal data, rectify inaccurate data or request its deletion, as well as to request restriction, objection to, or portability of their data, by writing to jactive@gmail.com [or contacto@chaiactive.com] specifying the right they wish to exercise. They also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es) if they believe processing does not comply with applicable regulations.

sections.heading: Security measures
paragraphs: THE OWNER adopts the technical and organizational measures necessary to guarantee the security of personal data processed and to prevent its alteration, loss, unauthorized processing or access.

sections.heading: What are cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small files installed in the user's browser when visiting a website, which allow, among other things, storing and retrieving information about browsing habits or the user's device.

sections.heading: Cookies used on this Website
paragraphs: Technical (necessary) cookies: essential for the Website to function correctly (for example, remembering the selected language). These do not require consent.

Analytics cookies [pending confirmation of whether Google Analytics or another tool will be used]: allow us to measure visitor numbers and analyze how users use the Website, in order to improve the content offered. These require prior user consent.

Third-party cookies: the Website does not include third-party content that installs cookies. The WhatsApp link only opens the WhatsApp app or website when the user clicks it, and from then on WhatsApp's privacy policy applies. [Review if any external tool is added in the future.]

sections.heading: Managing cookies
paragraphs: On first accessing the Website, a consent banner will be shown where the user can accept all cookies, reject non-essential ones, or configure their preferences. Users can also delete or block cookies at any time through their browser settings.

sections.heading: More information
paragraphs: For any questions about this Cookie Policy, you can write to us at jactive@gmail.com [or contacto@chaiactive.com].

meta.title: Kehál, the app for Jewish communities | Chai Active
meta.description: Kehál: membership, Hebrew calendar, events, mikveh, donations, life-cycle services and Torah in one app with your community's identity. In use at Chabad Barcelona.

hero.title: Your community's life, in an app that carries its name.
hero.subtitle: Kehál brings membership, the Hebrew calendar, events, mikveh, donations and Torah together in one place, with your kehilla's colours, logo and languages. The whole app, or just the modules you need.
hero.ctaSecondary: Talk to us about your community

modulos.title: The whole app, or just what you need
modulos.intro: Kehál is built from modules. You can start with events and donations and add the mikveh or the directory later. Each module works on its own and they all share the same members.

items.title: Membership
items.body: Member sign-up with identity verification and manual approval by the team. Nobody joins without the community knowing.

items.title: Hebrew calendar
items.body: Hebrew dates, holidays, the weekly parasha and halachic times for your city, always up to date.

items.title: Events with capacity
items.body: One-click sign-up, limited places and an attendee list for the team, no spreadsheets.

items.title: Mikveh
items.body: Appointment booking with discretion and privacy, on the schedule the community sets.

items.title: Donations by area
items.body: Each donation goes to the area the donor chooses: education, kashrut, welfare or whatever you define.

items.title: Life cycle
items.body: Requests for Bar and Bat Mitzvah, Brit Milah, weddings and Nachala, tracked in one place.

items.title: Torah and shiurim
items.body: Classes, materials and Torah content to learn during the week.

items.title: Jconnect
items.body: Jewish Business & Co-Work directory: members list their business and find people to work with.

items.title: Admin dashboard
items.body: Members, events, donations, bookings and communications managed from a single dashboard.

caso.title: Chabad Barcelona
caso.body: Kehál is the website and app of the Chabad Barcelona community, at bcnkehila.com. Members log in with their account, newcomers request access and the team approves it. Events, mikveh, donations and the calendar, all in one place.

cta.body: Tell us how you organise things today and we'll show you Kehál with your name and colours.

demo.title: Try it yourself
demo.intro: This is the real app, with a sample community. Log in as a member or as an admin and move around it as you would on your phone.

meta.title: A dedicated app for Jewish schools | Chai Active
meta.description: Academic tracking, communication with families and Jewish life built into an app with your school's identity. We are looking for pilot schools.

hero.title: School life at a Jewish school, in one app with its own identity.
hero.subtitle: We have designed a dedicated app for students, teachers and families: grades, homework, attendance and messages in one place, with the Hebrew calendar and Jewish life built in. We are in conversations with schools in Barcelona and ready to start with pilot schools.
hero.ctaSecondary: Let's start with a pilot group

pilares.title: Three pillars
pilares.intro: What we have learned from talking with schools comes down to three things a school app has to do well.

items.title: Continuous academic tracking
items.body: Grades, homework and attendance up to date, so nobody discovers a problem at the end-of-term meeting.

items.title: Direct, organised communication
items.body: Messages, notices and permission slips in one channel, without relying on stray emails or WhatsApp groups.

items.title: Identity and community
items.body: The app carries the school's name and colours, and Jewish life is built in, not bolted on at the end.

perfiles.title: Six profiles. Each sees only what is theirs.
perfiles.intro: Everyone logs in with their own account and sees what applies to them. Roles can be combined: a teacher who is also a mother uses one account and switches view.

items.title: Student
items.body: Their timetable, homework, grades and messages from their teachers.

items.title: Family or legal guardian
items.body: Each child's day to day, notices, permission slips and meetings.

items.title: Teacher
items.body: Their groups, taking the register, marking and talking to students and families.

items.title: Form tutor or co-tutor
items.body: The full view of their class and the progress of each student.

items.title: Coordination and head of studies
items.body: Timetables, cover, exam calendar and reports by stage.

items.title: Leadership and administration
items.body: School settings, permissions, documents and overall indicators.

perfiles.security: Least privilege: nobody sees more than they need. And every access to a student's data is logged.

app.title: The app in five sections
app.intro: Simple navigation with five tabs at the bottom. Anything people check often is two taps away at most. Tap the tabs on the phone to see it.

inicio.notice: Trip to the Great Synagogue on Thursday. Permission slip awaiting signature.

calendario.shabat: Shabbat candle lighting in Barcelona: time calculated by the app

items.text: Remember the parents' meeting on Thursday.
Room change: Chemistry moves to the lab.
Very good work on the essay.

tabsInfo.inicio: what's on today, notices and to-dos
tabsInfo.materias: grades, homework and progress by subject

modulos.intro: Modules designed for a school's day to day. The school decides which ones to switch on.

profesorado.title: For teachers and leadership
profesorado.intro: If teachers don't save time, the app is useless. That's why the teacher dashboard is the first thing we designed.

items.title: Teacher dashboard
items.body: Their groups, what needs marking and what's happening today, on one screen.

items.title: Fast marking
items.body: Mark, comment and grade without switching screens.

items.title: Templates
items.body: Reusable homework, rubrics and notices from one year to the next.

items.title: Tutor's class view
items.body: Grades, attendance and notes for the whole class at a glance.

items.title: Spotting students at risk
items.body: Early signals when absences, missed hand-ins or low grades pile up.

items.title: Timetable builder
items.body: Timetables, rooms and cover with conflict warnings.

items.title: Exportable reports
items.body: Reports by student, class or stage, ready to download.

items.title: Bulk import
items.body: Students, groups and staff imported from a spreadsheet.

privacidad.title: Privacy and security
privacidad.intro: We are talking about children's data. This is what we commit to, in writing, before we start.

items.title: The data belongs to the school
items.body: The school is the data controller. We only process data on its instructions.

items.title: GDPR and LOPDGDD
items.body: Designed to comply with the General Data Protection Regulation and Spanish law.

items.title: Hosted in the EU
items.body: Data is stored on servers inside the European Union.

items.title: Encryption
items.body: Information encrypted in transit and at rest.

items.title: Two-step verification
items.body: Mandatory for teachers and administration.

items.title: Sensitive data kept separate
items.body: The most delicate information is stored apart, with more restricted access.

items.title: Impact assessment
items.body: Before launch, because it involves children's data.

items.title: No advertising or model training
items.body: The data is not used for advertising or to train artificial intelligence models.

items.title: Free export
items.body: The school can export all its data whenever it wants.

futuro.title: Where it could grow
futuro.intro: Extensions we have in mind for later. They are not part of the first pilot.
items: AI study assistant, under the school's control
Digital ID card with QR code
Extension to nursery, primary and lower secondary

empezamos.title: How we start
empezamos.intro: No changing everything at once. We start small, learn with you and grow once it works.

steps.title: Meeting with leadership
steps.body: We understand how your school works and what takes up most of your time.

steps.title: Pilot with one year group
steps.body: We start with one year group or a specific stage.

steps.title: Short teacher training
steps.body: Short, practical sessions, no endless manuals.

steps.title: Support during the first year
steps.body: We stay close to answer questions and adjust whatever is needed.

steps.title: Rollout to the whole school
steps.body: Once the pilot works, we extend it to the other year groups.

cta.body: We are in conversations with schools in Barcelona and are looking for pilot schools. If you're interested, let's talk.

servicios.title: What we do for businesses

items.title: Corporate website
items.body: A website that clearly explains what you do and conveys who you are, easy to update.

items.title: E-commerce

items.title: Launch page

items.title: Forms and contact flows
items.body: Step-by-step forms that send each lead to the right channel: email, phone call or WhatsApp.

items.title: Multilingual
items.body: Your website in your customers' languages, including Hebrew with right-to-left text.

items.title: SEO

steps.title: Conversation
steps.body: You tell us about your business, your customers and what you want to achieve. No commitment.

steps.title: Design

steps.title: Development

steps.title: Launch and support

seguridad.title: Your data, under lock and key.
seguridad.intro: We work with data from communities, families and businesses. We keep it with certified providers, and each person sees only what's theirs.

items.title: Encryption at rest
items.body: The database and its backups are encrypted with AES-256 in Supabase.

items.title: Encryption in transit
items.body: Everything travels over HTTPS with TLS between the phone or computer and the server.

items.title: Certified providers
items.body: Supabase stores the data and Vercel serves the websites. Both hold ISO 27001 and a SOC 2 type 2 audit.

items.title: Data in Europe
items.body: The databases for Kehál and the shops we build sit in data centres in Zurich and Ireland.

items.title: Everyone sees their own
items.body: Access rules live in the database itself: a member only sees their own data, and only people with that role can open the admin panel.

items.title: Minimal data
items.body: We ask only for what's needed, and any user can delete their account from the app.
